sources.locator: "Battle of the Pyrenees", revision 1370601915, lead and § Background

explanation: The offensive was the answer to the defeat, and the article says so: "After the decisive French defeat at the Battle of Vitoria, Marshal Soult consolidated the remnants of four armies into a single force of 80,000 troops." Its lead gives the order and the object — a "large-scale offensive launched on 25 July 1813 by Marshal Jean-de-Dieu Soult from the Pyrénées region on Emperor Napoleon's order, in the hope of relieving French garrisons under siege at Pamplona and San Sebastián" — both of which were besieged because of what Vitoria had lost. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
